<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#343541"/>
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="25" fill="#343541"/>
  <text x="18" y="17" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="330" y1="15" x2="334" y2="15" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="13" x2="341" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="11" x2="348" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="359" y1="15" x2="362" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="8" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="371" y="10" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="386" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="25" width="390" height="55" fill="#343541"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="79" x2="390" y2="79" stroke="#444654" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="19" y1="45" x2="39" y2="45" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="19" y1="51" x2="39" y2="51" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="19" y1="57" x2="39" y2="57" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="55" y="58" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">UX Design Chat</text>
  <circle cx="355" cy="52" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="46" x2="355" y2="58" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="349" y1="52" x2="361" y2="52" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- user message -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="28" cy="108" r="16" fill="#D2CECE"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="103" r="5" fill="#343541"/>
    <ellipse cx="28" cy="114" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#343541"/>
    <text x="55" y="103" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">You</text>
    <text x="55" y="124" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">How can I improve the UX design of a</text>
    <text x="55" y="145" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">mobile banking app for first-time users?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- assistant response card shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="168" width="390" height="376" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
  <rect x="0" y="166" width="390" height="376" fill="#444654"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="184" width="24" height="24" rx="2" fill="#0FA47F"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="196" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="190" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="202" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="193" x2="32" y2="199" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="193" x2="24" y2="199" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="52" y="202" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">ChatGPT</text>

    <text x="16" y="232" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">For first-time users, focus on building trust and</text>
    <text x="16" y="253" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">reducing cognitive load at every step. Consider</text>
    <text x="16" y="274" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF">these UX improvements:</text>

    <text x="16" y="306" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">1. Create a welcoming first-run experience</text>
    <text x="26" y="327" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Explain the app’s value in plain language and</text>
    <text x="26" y="347" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">guide users through one short, low-risk task.</text>

    <text x="16" y="379" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">2. Make security visible, not intimidating</text>
    <text x="26" y="400" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Use familiar labels, biometric sign-in, and clear</text>
    <text x="26" y="420" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">confirmation states for important actions.</text>

    <text x="16" y="452" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">3. Prioritize a simple home dashboard</text>
    <text x="26" y="473" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Lead with balance, recent activity, and one clear</text>
    <text x="26" y="493" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">next action. Hide advanced tools until needed.</text>

    <text x="16" y="521" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="13" fill="#D6D6D6">Would you like a sample onboarding flow or wireframe?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- response controls -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="562" width="174" height="38" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="34,580 38,584 45,576" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="56" y="585" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Regenerate response</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="562" width="70" height="38" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="218" y="585" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Copy</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="284" y="562" width="90" height="38" rx="4" fill="#0FA47F"/>
    <text x="301" y="585" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- composer -->
  <rect x="15" y="620" width="360" height="58" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2"/>
  <rect x="15" y="618" width="360" height="58" rx="8" fill="#40414F"/>
  <text x="31" y="653" font-family="Product Sans" font-size="16" fill="#D6D6D6">Message ChatGPT</text>
  <circle cx="348" cy="647" r="15" fill="#0FA47F"/>
  <polyline points="341,647 352,642 349,653" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="647" x2="352" y2="642" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="15" y="696" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#D6D6D6">ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.</text>
  <text x="15" y="713" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#D6D6D6">Release notes  ·  v1.0.0</text>
  <text x="375" y="713" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FF8BFF">What's new</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="731" width="390" height="113" fill="#0E0E0E"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="731" x2="390" y2="731" stroke="#444654" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,757 51,747 63,757 63,773 54,773 54,763 48,763 48,773 39,773" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="51" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="758" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#0FA47F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="752" x2="127" y2="764" stroke="#0FA47F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="758" x2="133" y2="758" stroke="#0FA47F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="127" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#0FA47F">New chat</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="190" y="748" width="20" height="17" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="195,765 195,770 201,765" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="200" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">History</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="274" cy="755" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="274" cy="769" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="274" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Account</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="348" cy="758" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="758" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="347" y="745" width="2" height="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="347" y="767" width="2" height="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="335" y="757" width="4" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="357" y="757" width="4" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="348" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">Settings</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="170" y1="825" x2="220" y2="825" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
